question: What trials are studying pembrolizumab for Erdheim-Chester disease?

answer.answer_md:
No trials in this index study pembrolizumab for Erdheim-Chester disease.

I checked the definition-of-record program view (`v_programs`, asset = pembrolizumab, condition = Erdheim-Chester Disease, MeSH D031249) and it returned **0 rows**. A direct check of the raw trial-assets/trial-conditions join for this asset/condition pair (any role — subject, comparator, or unknown) also returned **0 rows**.

Erdheim-Chester Disease itself has 22 trials in the index (condition_key D031249), but none of them include pembrolizumab as an intervention.

This does not prove pembrolizumab has never been tried off-label or in a case series for this ultra-rare histiocytic disorder — only that no such trial is present in this ClinicalTrials.gov-derived snapshot (as of 2026-09-04).
caveats: v_programs and a direct trial_assets/trial_conditions_norm join both returned zero rows for this asset+condition pair — absence from this index is not proof the combination has never been studied anywhere (snapshot 2026-09-04, ClinicalTrials.gov-derived).
Erdheim-Chester Disease has 22 trials total in the index, but pembrolizumab is not among the interventions in any of them.

SELECT p.asset_id, a.canonical_name, p.max_phase_active, p.max_phase_ever, p.n_active_trials, p.n_trials, p.nct_ids, p.lead_company_of_most_advanced
FROM v_programs p JOIN assets a USING (asset_id)
WHERE p.condition_key = 'D031249' AND p.asset_id = 'pembrolizumab'

SELECT nct_id, role FROM trial_assets ta
JOIN trial_conditions_norm tc USING (nct_id)
WHERE ta.asset_id = 'pembrolizumab' AND tc.condition_key = 'D031249'

SELECT p.asset_id, a.canonical_name, p.max_phase_active, p.max_phase_ever, p.n_active_trials, p.n_trials, p.nct_ids
FROM v_programs p JOIN assets a USING (asset_id) WHERE p.condition_key = 'D002292' AND NOT a.is_combo
ORDER BY p.max_phase_active DESC NULLS LAST, p.n_active_trials DESC;
-- most active industry lead sponsors in an indication (Q3 default: industry, ranked by active trials, total as tiebreak)
SELECT company_name, n_active_trials, n_trials, n_assets, n_phase3_plus FROM v_sponsor_condition
WHERE condition_key = 'D009101' AND agency_class = 'INDUSTRY' ORDER BY n_active_trials DESC, n_trials DESC LIMIT 10;
-- combination partners anchored on an ASSET in an indication
SELECT cp.partner_asset_id, a.canonical_name, count(DISTINCT cp.nct_id) AS n_trials, max(cp.phase_rank) AS max_phase,
       list(DISTINCT cp.nct_id) AS nct_ids FROM v_combo_partners cp JOIN assets a ON a.asset_id = cp.partner_asset_id
WHERE cp.asset_id = 'pembrolizumab' AND cp.condition_key = 'D002292' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY n_trials DESC;

SELECT cp.partner_asset_id, count(DISTINCT cp.nct_id) AS n_trials, list(DISTINCT cp.nct_id) AS nct_ids
FROM v_combo_partners cp JOIN v_moa m ON m.asset_id = cp.asset_id
WHERE m.moa_key = 'pdcd1' AND cp.condition_key = 'D002289' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n_trials DESC;
-- the MoA labeled-fraction query (state this in every MoA/target answer)
WITH scope AS (SELECT DISTINCT asset_id FROM v_programs WHERE condition_key = 'D054990')
SELECT coalesce(b.provenance, 'none') AS tier, count(*) AS n_assets FROM scope s LEFT JOIN v_moa_best b USING (asset_id) GROUP BY 1;
